# Total.js actions AI kit

> Rules, a template and a checker so an AI model can create Total.js 5 actions (NEWACTION) and their tests from a natural-language description: an action folder actions/<name>/ with <name>.js and a test file in tests/.

Plain JavaScript (ES5 style), no TypeScript. Requires total5@beta.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs/actions/main/AGENTS.md): What this repository is and how to use it
- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs/actions/main/SKILL.md): Workflow, rules, the test and the checklist to create an action
- [Template: example.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs/actions/main/example/example.js): The reference action
- [Template: example/test.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs/actions/main/example/test.js): The reference test: calls the action and checks the result

## Reference

- [API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs/actions/main/docs/api.md): Options of NEWACTION, the $ object, types of input and output, calling an action, REQUEST and the test library
- [Documentation](https://docs.totaljs.com): Total.js documentation

## Optional

- [Checker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs/actions/main/tools/check.js): Checks the action folders and runs the tests
